pipeline_name: Low Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid Network

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded StartLocation='Eklera' is not supported by any source about THIS pipeline -- it appears to belong to the sibling GSPL High Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid (P0927) instead, so per standing rule 3 (never propose refs for a different value) this stays UNRESOLVED rather than cited. Independently re-verified the deep-sweep audit's finding by downloading and OCR'ing (pdftoppm+tesseract; both PDFs are scanned images with no text layer, pdftotext returns 0 lines) the two most specific PNGRB/GSPL documents myself: (1) PNGRB's 19.03.2013 Grant of Authorization (letter19march.pdf), whose Schedule D lists this pipeline's authorized route as three trunk lines -- '(a) Hazira-Mora-Utran, (b) Cairn-Mora, (c) PMT Connectivity to Mora' -- with no mention of Eklera anywhere in the 8-page OCR text; (2) GSPL's own 29.05.2018 PNGRB Access Code Schedule-I filing (gsp1209.pdf), which covers BOTH GSPL networks in one packet and lets the two be compared directly: the 'Atakpardi-Eklera Section' appears explicitly under the filing's 'GSPL's High Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid' entity table (OCR line 65: 'Name of pipeline GSPL's High Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid' / 'Atiakpardi-Eklera Section (HP network 2011-12): 43 mmscmd'), whereas the separate 'GSPL's Low Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid' table in the same document (OCR line ~246 onward, this pipeline) itemizes its sections as Hazira-Mora (49 MMSCMD), Cairn-Mora (19 MMSCMD) and Mora-Utran (1 MMSCMD) -- Hazira/Mora/Utran/Cairn throughout, no Eklera. So the two GSPL networks are cleanly distinguished in the SAME source document, and Eklera sits only on the High Pressure side. EndLocation='Hazira' and both StartState/EndState='Gujarat' are consistent with these sources and not in dispute -- only StartLocation='Eklera' is unsupported. This is a value-correction question (StartLocation likely belongs on P0927, or should read Hazira/Mora/Utran-corridor here), not a ref-add, so it routes to Update per SOP rather than being cited here. Also checked the GIDB page (gidb.org / gidb.gujarat.gov.in) named in the wiki citation for this claim: both the live domain and a 2021 Wayback snapshot are unreachable or return only a generic GSPL 1,550 km network overview with no section-level detail, so it cannot corroborate 'Eklera' either way. No fresh source search beyond re-verifying the deep-sweep's own leads was productive, since the disagreement is structural (wrong pipeline in GEM's field), not a missing-citation problem a new source would fix.
